“
Always read the fine print.
„
— Errant Soul, stuck in the House of Hope

Involvement

Act Three

Errant Souls are inside the House of Hope. They spawn randomly near the party and utter some words before disappearing again. They cannot be interacted with.

Quotes

  • "Creeping, stalking, walking, crawling. I see you."
  • "I miss the sun. I miss the stars."
  • "Hurt me. Please."
  • "Time to wake up, time to wake up, time to wake up."
  • "So many pretty things in the House of Hope. You're the prettiest of all."
  • "Always read the fine print."
  • "Raphael sees everything you do."
  • "Raphael hears everything you say."
  • "Can't sleep. So tired. Can't sleep."
  • "I am air, I am light, I am free."
  • "I deserve this. Thank you. Thank you."
  • "Every day there is less of me."
  • "I can't feel my legs... I can't feel my skin."
  • "I made a mistake. I shouldn't be here. Let me take it back."
  • "Am I alone here? I can't see, I can't hear, I can't feel."
  • "Listen. LISTEN."
  • "I was going to be married tomorrow. Or was it yesterday?"
  • "The gods cannot see me here."
  • "Such a beautiful house. Such a beautiful prison."
  • "This place is all entrances and no exits."
  • "It's hot. It's cold. It's hot. It's cold."
  • "Never sign your soul away."
  • "There was a shadow at my door, I opened up and am no more."
